description: Get the current billing cycle usage and plan limits. Returns {start_period, end_period, plan_name, is_trial, storage, storage_plan, traffic, traffic_plan (all MB), play, play_plan, live, live_plan, live_count}. live = live minutes used this cycle (whole account, all regions); live_plan = free live minutes informed in the plan; live_count = lives in the cycle. Live minutes above live_plan are billed per minute by region and quality: see panda_get_subscription → addons.live. Trial accounts (is_trial) cannot create lives.
name: panda_get_plan_usage
title: Get Plan Usage
